༄༅// dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ smon lam gdab pa'i mdo/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrug pa la phyag bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'od 'phro la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba'i dbang po la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa ting nge 'dzin gyi glang po dam pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa padma mchog gi dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mchog gi dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa gdugs gcig pa la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa padma'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa dga' ba'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu yongs su rdzogs pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa dbang po tog gi rgyal mtshan gyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu rnam par gnon pa grags pa mchog gi dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa g.yul las shin tu rnam par rgyal ba'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan bkod pa shin tu snang ba'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi rgyal po dpal thob pa med pa la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i padma rnam par gnon pa bzhugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che padmar rab tu gnas pa'i sa la'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa shin tu nges pa'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla bai ḍūrya 'od kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa padma'i spyan la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa spyan gsal rgyal ba la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen gtsug tor can la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa 'brug sgra la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje snying po la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'od 'phro la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa klu pa la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa dpal byin la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs pa la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs pa'i byin la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa chu lha la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa chu lha'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa dpal bzang la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa tsan dan dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa sred med kyi bu la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa me tog dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs pa'i 'od zer rnam par rol pa mngon par mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa padma'i 'od zer mngon par shes pa rnam par rol pa la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa nor dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa dran pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan dpal shin tu yongs bsgrags kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa dbang po tog gi rgyal mtshan gyi rgyal pa la phyag 'tshal// de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu rnam par gnon pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa g.yul las shin tu rnam par rgyal ba la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa sna tshogs zab pa la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par bzhud pa la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa kun nas snang bas brgyan pa la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen padma rnam par gnon pa phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i padmar rab tu bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas ri dbang gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// de dag la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ma lus pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// gsung rabs dam pa'i chos mdo yi sde la phyag 'tshal lo// dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo// lung du bstan pa'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo// tshigs su bcad pa'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo// ched du brjod pa'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo// gleng gzhi'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo// rtogs pa brjod pa'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo// de ltar 'byung ba'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo// skyes pa rabs kyi sde la phyag 'tshal lo// shin tu rgyas pa'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo// rmad du byung ba'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo// gtan la phab pa'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo// de dag la sogs pa gsung rabs bzhugs so 'tshal ma lus pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// chos kyi rgyal po chen po longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/

bcom ldan 'das dpal rnam par snang mdzad rdo rje dbyings chen po ye shes kyi khyad par las sprul pa'i sku/ 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams thams cad na 'khor ba ji srid kyi bar du/ sems can dpag tu med pa rnams kyi don mdzad pa la brtson pa'i sems dpa' chen po rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// sems dpa' chen po rdo rje rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// sems dpa' chen po rdo rje chags pa la phyag 'tshal lo// sems dpa' chen po rdo rje legs pa la phyag 'tshal lo// sems dpa' chen po rdo rje rin chen la phyag 'tshal lo// sems dpa' chen po rdo rje gzi brjid la phyag 'tshal lo// sems dpa' chen po rdo rje rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo// sems dpa' chen po rdo rje bzhed pa la phyag 'tshal lo// sems dpa' chen po rdo rje chos la phyag 'tshal lo// sems dpa' chen pa rdo rje rnon po la phyag 'tshal lo// sems dpa' chen po rdo rje 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo// sems dpa' chen po rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal lo// sems dpa' chen po rdo rje 'phrin las la phyag 'tshal lo// sems dpa' chen po rdo rje go cha la phyag 'tshal lo// sems dpa' chen po rdo rje gnod sbyin la phyag 'tshal lo// sems dpa' chen po rdo rje khu tshur la phyag 'tshal lo// de dag la sogs te dpa' chen po rdo rje'i tshogs ma lus pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po snying rje chen po dang ldan pa/ sa chen po la rab tu gnas pa/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na sems can rnams kyi don mdzad pa la brtson pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dpa' bar 'gro ba la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' zla 'od la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' bzang spyod la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' dran pa la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i mdzod la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' dran pa can gyi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying po la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' 'od dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' mya ngan rab tu 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' ye shes tog la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' spobs pa brtsegs la phyag 'chal lo// byang chub sems dpa' blo gros mi zad pa la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' spos kyi glang po che la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' don yod grub pa la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' ngan song thams cad sbyong ba la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' rin po che'i tog la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa rnam par sel ba la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' lag na rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' mthu chen thob pa la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' dri ma med pa grags pa la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chu sems dpa' rin chen blo gros la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' me'i snying po la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' 'phel ba'i blo gros la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' ye shes snying po la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' kun nas 'od zer la phyag 'tshal/

byang chub sems dpa' mya ngan med pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' spyod pa'i blo gros la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' rgyal bas byin la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' rnam par rgyal bas rnam par gnon pa la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' lag na padmo la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' nyi ma'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' rin chen mchog la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' padmo mchog la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' dga' bas byin la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' mthong ba don yod la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' rin chen cod pan la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' sprin gyi snying po la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' 'brug sgra'i snying po la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' g.yul las shin tu rnam par rgyal ba la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' padma'i yan lag dang ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' sbyor ba'i lam nges par 'byed pa'i cha bzhi 'byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' rab tu dga' ba'i sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' dri ma med pa'i sa la gnas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' 'od byed pa'i sa la gnas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' 'od 'phro ba can gyi sa la gnas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' shan tu sbyang dka' ba'i sa la gnas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' mngon du gyur pa'i sa la gnas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' ring du song ba'i sa la gnas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' mi g.yo ba'i sa la gnas pa rnams la phyag 'chal lo// byang chub sems dpa' legs pa'i blo gros kyi sa la gnas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi sprin gyi sa la gnas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// de dag la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs ma lus pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa rang sangs rgyas kyi dge 'dun gyis gang zag dang chos kyi phyogs gcig la bdag med par rtogs shing*/

rten 'brel gyi don zab mo thugs su chud pa'i bse ru gcig lta bur gnas pa'am bya bzhin du khyur lding ba'i tshogs ma lus pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// gzhan yang 'phags pa nyan thos dgra bcom pa lo// 'phags pa lam bstan la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa rdo rje mo'i bu la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa klu sde la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa yan lag 'byung la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa nags na gnas pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa mi pham pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa lam phran la phyag 'tshal lo// de dag la sogs pa'i 'phags pa nyan thos da gra bcom pa'i tshogs ma lus pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// rig pa'i lha mo chen mo rdo rje dbyings phyug ma la phyag 'tshal lo// rig pa'i lha mo chen mo btsun ldan mol phyag 'tshal lo// rig pa'i lha mo chen mo nag mol phyag 'tshal lo// rig pa'i lha mo chen mo rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo la phyag 'tshal lo// rig pa'i lha mo chen mo so so 'brang ma chen mo la phyag 'tshal lo// rig pa'i lha mo chen mo de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyi mi thub ma phyir zlog pa chen mo la phyag 'tshal lo// yum chen mo sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo// yum chen mo tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo// yum chen mo bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo// yum chen mo brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo// yum chen mo bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo// yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo// yum chen mo thabs kyi pha rol tu phyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo// yum chen mo stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo// yum chen mo smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo// yum chen mo ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo// yum chen mo rdo rje sems ma la phyag 'tshal lo// yum chen mo chos kyi rdo rje ma la phyag 'tshal lo// yum chen mo rin chen rdo rje ma la phyag 'tshal lo// yum chen mo padma rdo rje ma la phyag 'tshal lo// yum chen mo las kyi rdo rje ma la phyag 'tshal lo// yum chen mo nam mkha'i spyan ma la phyag 'tshal lo// yum chen mo sangs rgyas spyan ma la phyag 'tshal lo// yum chen mo ma ma ki la phyag 'tshal lo// yum chen mo gos dkar mo la phyag 'tshal lo// yum chen mo sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// rig sngags kyi rgyal mo khro gnyer can la phyag 'tshal lo// rig sngags kyi lha mo grags ldan ma la phyag 'tshal lo// rig sngags kyi lha mo dpal ldan lha mo chen mo la phyag 'tshal lo// rig sngags kyi lha mo dkar mo chen mo la phyag 'tshal lo// rig sngags kyi lha mo dkar sham mo la phyag 'tshal lo// rig sngags kyi lha mo rdo rje lcags kyu ma la phyag 'tshal lo// rig sngags kyi lha mo rdo rje khu tshur ma la phyag 'tshal lo// rig sngags kyi lha mo rdo rje mchog 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal lo// rig sngags kyi lha mo rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma la phyag 'tshal lo// rig sngags kyi lha mo rdo rje dga' ba mo la phyag 'tshal lo// rig sngags kyi lha mo rdo rje sgeg mo la phyag 'tshal lo// rig sngags kyi lha mo rdo rje 'phreng ba mo la phyag 'tshal lo// rig sngags kyi lha mo rdo rje glu ma la phyag 'tshal lo// rig sngags kyi lha mo rdo rje grub pa ma la phyag 'tshal lo// rig sngags kyi lha mo rdo rje gar mkhan ma la phyag 'tshal lo// rig sngags kyi lha mo rdo rje bdug pa ma la phyag 'tshal lo// rig sngags kyi lha mo rdo rje me tog ma la phyag 'tshal lo// rig sngags kyi lha mo rdo rje mar me ma la phyag 'tshal lo// rig sngags kyi lha mo rdo rje chen po nyi ma me la phyag 'tshal lo// khro bo'i rgyal po chen po khro zla la phyag 'tshal lo// khro bo'i rgyal po chen po gnod mdzes la phyag 'tshal lo// khro bo'i rgyal po chen po khro sdud kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// khro bo'i rgyal po chen po khros pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// khre bo'i rgyal po rab tu grub pa la phyag 'tshal lo// khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi thabs sbyor la phyag 'tshal lo// khro bo'i rgyal po tra bhid ta la phyag 'tshal lo// khro bo'i rgyal po gtum po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// khro bo'i rgyal po stobs po che la phyag 'tshal lo// khro bo'i rgyal po chen po dpal ldan gzhan gyis mi thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo// khro bo'i rgyal po chen po rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo// khro bo'i rgyal po chen po rdo rje yangs pa la phyag 'tshal lo// khro bo'i rgyal po chen po rdo rje byis pa ki li ki la ya la phyag 'tshal lo// khro bo'i rgyal po chen po snying po mchog la phyag 'tshal lo// khro bo'i rgyal po chen po rdo rje phur bu la phyag 'tshal lo// khro bo'i rgyal po chen po rdo rje be con la phyag 'tshal lo// khro bo'i rgyal po chen po rdo rje tho ba la phyag 'tshal lo// khro bo'i rgyal po chen po rdo rje khur tshur la phyag 'tshal lo// khro bo'i rgyal po chen po rdo rje gom pa 'dor la phyag 'tshal lo// de dag la sogs pa'i khro bo'i tshogs ma lus pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// khro mo chen mo gzhan gyis mi thub ma la phyag 'tshal lo// khro mo padma bri ku ta la phyag 'tshal lo// khro mo ral pa gcig ma la phyag 'tshal lo// khro mo rdo rje rtse mo la phyag 'tshal lo// khro mo mi 'jigs ma la phyag 'tshal lo// khro mo 'jigs pa thams cad sel ma la phyag 'tshal lo// khro mo gdul dka' ma la phyag 'tshal lo// khro mo ma 'dul ba rdo rje 'dul ba la phyag 'tshal lo// khro mo parṇa sha ri la phyag 'tshal lo// de dag la sogs pa'i khro mo tshogs ma lus thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// gzhan yang sku gdung dang ring srel la sogs pa mchod gnas bla mar gyur pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// tshangs pa dang brgya byin dang*/

rgyal po chen po bzhi dang*/ phyogs skyong ba bcu dang gtsug lag khang gi bdag po la sogs pa/ lha ma srin sde brgyad kyis bsdus pa'i bstan pa bsrung ba'i dam tshig can rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag gis dus 'di nas bzung ste/ byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug gi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog /chos la skyabs su mchi'o// tshogs rnams kyi mchog /dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas 'khor ba na 'khor ba'i tshe/ ma rig pas bsgribs te/ bdag gis sangs rgyas dang yon tan thams cad kyi mnga' bdag chos thams cad kyi bdud rtsi dang dge 'dun 'phags pa'i shes rab kyis nyon mongs pa rim par spangs te/ dkon mchog sum po de dag gi rang bzhin dang yon tan ma 'tshal nas/ dkon mchog gsum la phyogs shing rim gro ma bgyis pa dang*/ pha ma dang mkhan po dang*/ slob dpon dang*/ bla ma mchod pa'i gnas su gyur pa rnams la/ srid zhu dang*/ rim gro dang*/ bsnyen bkur ma bgyis pa dang*/ sdig pa mang po ci mchis pa thams cad bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis mthol zhing bshags so// dkon mchog gsum la mi snyan pa brjod pa dang*/ ngan du bsam pa dang*/ spangs pa dang*/ gnod pa bgyid pa dang*/ bgyid du stsal ba dang*/ bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i sdig pa thams cad bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis mthol zhing bshags so// bdag gis chags shing brkam pa'i dbang gis/ sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun gyi dkor la rku 'phrog bgyid pa dang*/ rku 'phrog bgyid du stsal ba dang*/ rku 'phrog bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i sdig pa thams cad ma lus par/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis mthol zhing so sor bshags so// lus dang srog dang*/

longs spyod la chags nas/ bdag gis sems can gyi srog bcad pa dang*/ gzhan gyi nor bkus pa dang*/ phrogs pa dang*/ tshangs pa spyod pa la dri ma can du spyad pa dang*/ rdzun dang*/ phra ma dang*/ tshig 'khyal pa dang*/ ngag rtsub mo dang*/ brnab sems dang*/ gnod sems dang*/ log par lta ba dang*/ mi dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam rnams bdag nyid kyis bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du bstsal ba dang*/ bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i sdig pa ci mchis pa de dag thams cad/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis mthol zhing bshags so// las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis/ mtshams med pa lnga po/ pha bsad pa dang*/ ma bsad pa dang*/ dgra bcom pa bsad pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi dbyen byas pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la ngan sems kyis khrag phyung ba dang*/ bdag cag gis bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du stsal ba dang*/ bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i sdig pa ci mchis pa thams cad/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis ma lus par mthol zhing bshags so// mtshams med pa lnga dang nye ba lnga ste/ ma dgra bcom ma sun 'byin par byed pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' nges pa'i sa la gnas pa rnams bsad pa dang*/ slob ma bsad pa dang*/ dge 'dun 'du ba'i sgo phrogs pa dang*/ mchod rten 'jig par bgyid pa dang*/ bdag gis bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du stsal ba dang*/ bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i sdig pa ci mchis pa thams cad ma lus pa/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis mthol zhing bshags so// nyan thos kyi bslab pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dang*/ 'gal bar bgyis pa'i sdig pa ci mchis pa thams cad ma lus pa so sor bshags so// mdor na bag ma mchis pa'i dbang gis/ sdig pa'i grogs po'i dbang du gyur pa dang*/ phrag dog dang*/ ser sna dang*/ g.yo dang*/ sgyu dang*/ 'dod chags dang*/ zhe sdang dang*/ gti mug gi dbang du gyur pa dang*/ lus dang ngag dang*/ yid kyi sgo nas nyes par spyad pa dang*/

nyes par smras pa dang*/ nyes par bsam pa la sogs pa'i sdig pa ci mchis pa dang*/ mi dge ba'i las gang dag gis/ mtho ris su skye ba la bsgribs te/ ngan song du skye bar 'gyur ba dang*/ thar pa dang mtho ris su skye ba la bsgribs te/ khams gsum ngan song gsum du 'khor bar 'khyams par gyur pa'i sdig pa thams cad bdag gis bgyis shing bsha' ba dang*/ bsad pa dang*/ ci mchis pa thams cad mthol zhing bshags pas/ bdag dang gzhan gyi sdig pa ci mchis pa thams cad mthol zhing bshags so// ma lus par dag cing byang bar gyur cig /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal gshag pa dang*/ gtub pa dang*/ btso ba dang*/ bskrag pa dang*/ grang zhing sgrib pa la sogs pa thams cad gtan du rgyun chad par gyur cig /yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal bkres shing skom pa thams cad gtan du rgyun chad par gyur cig /byol song gi skye gnas kyi sdug bsngal bsad pa dang*/ bkol spyod la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa thams cad gtan du rgyun chad par gyur cig /mi khom pa brgyad gtan du rgyun chad par gyur cig /mi'i 'jig rten na sdug cing 'phongs pa dang*/ bye bral la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal thams cad gtan du rgyun chad par gyur cing ming yang mi grags par gyur cig /mi nad dang*/ phyugs nad dang*/ 'thab rtsod dang*/ mu ge la sogs pa'i gnod pa thams cad rgyun chad cing*/ ming yang mi grags par gyur cig /lha'i 'jig rten na 'chi 'pho ba dang*/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i gnod pa thams cad gtan du rgyun chad par gyur cig /bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe rabs kun tu sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par padmo la brdzus te skye bar gyur cig /dbang po thams cad tshang zhing skyon ma mchis par gyur cig /ngan song gsum dang*/ yul mtha' 'khob tu mi khom pa'i gnas dang*/ dman pa'i lus thams cad du las kyi dbang gis nam yang mi skye bar gyur cig

/rang dbang ma mchis shing yid mi bde ba'i sdug bsngal dang*/ lus la gnod pa'i sdug bsngal dang*/ sdug bsngal zhing 'phongs pa'i sdug bsngal nam du yang mi myong bar gyur cig /bdag dang sems can thams cad tshe rabs kun tu tshe ring phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ 'dod pa phun sum tshogs pa yid bzhin du 'grub cing*/ 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig /'jig rten pa dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan zhing tshe ring ba dang nad med par gyur cig /bdag dang sems can thams cad tshe rabs kun tu dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la gnas par gyur cig /dkon mchog gsum dang*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad dang nam yang mi 'bral zhing*/ de dag la me tog dang*/ bdug spos dang*/ zhal zas dang*/ na bza' dang*/ bla re dang*/ ba dan dang*/ gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad sna tshogs dang*/ rin po che la sogs pa'i dkor cha thams cad kyi mchod pa'i yo byad dpag tu ma mchis pas rgyun du mchod pa bgyid par gyur cig /bdag dang sems can thams cad tshe rabs kun tu chos nyan pa dang mi 'bral te/ len cing 'dzin pa dang*/ yi ger 'bri zhing klog pa dang*/ kun chub par bgyid pa dang*/ gzhan dag la yang don ma nor bar ston par gyur cig /don ji ltar rtogs pa bzhin du nan tan gyis bsgrub cing*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rigs brgyud mi 'chad par gyur cig /bdag dang sems can thams cad tshe rabs dran nas/ mi dge ba spong zhing dge ba la 'dzud par gyur cig /bdag dang sems can thams cad tshe rabs kun tu nyon mongs pa'i chu bo las ma brgal ba rnams sgrol ba dang*/ khams gsum las ma thar ba rnams thar bar bgyis pa dang*/ sdug bsngal gyis nyen pa rnams dbugs 'byin par byed pa dang*/ nyon mongs pas gzir ba rnams yongs su mya ngan las zlo ba/

shes bya chags pa med pa dang*/ thogs pa med pa'i ye shes rnams ma thob pa rnams/ thams can mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob par bgyid pa dang*/ byang chub kyi sems dam pa dang mi 'bral zhing ldan par gyur cig /bdag dang sems can thams cad tshe rabs kun tu tshad med pa bzhi po/ byams pa dang*/ snying rje dang*/ dga' ba dang*/ btang snyoms la gnas pa ste/ gcig la gcig gnod pa mi bgyid pa dang*/ phan pa bsgrub par gyur cig /bdag dang sems can thams cad tshe rabs kun tu bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi po/ sbyin pa dang*/ snyan par smra ba dang*/ don spyod pa dang*/ don mthun pas/ sems can rnams bsdus te yang dag pa'i las la 'dzud par gyur cig /bdag dang sems can thams cad tshe rabs kun tu mngon par shes pa lnga po dang*/ lha'i mig dang*/ rna ba dang*/ pha rol gyi sems shes shing*/ sems kyi rnam grangs shes pa dang*/ sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa dang*/ rdzu 'phrul gyi bya ba byed shes pa dang*/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi po/ chos so so yang dag par rig pa dang*/ don so so yang dag par rig pa dang*/ nges pa'i tshigs so so yang dag par rig pa dang*/ spobs pa so so yang dag par rig pa dang ldan te/ sems can gyi bsam pa rtogs nas/ mos pa ji lta ba bzhin du/ cho 'phrul sna tshogs kyis 'dul zhing khyad par gyi chos ston te/ theg pa chen po la 'dzud par gyur cig /bdag dang sems can thams cad tshe rabs kun tu dbang bcu po/ tshe rabs la dbang ba dang*/ sems la dbang ba dang*/ yo byad la dbang ba dang*/ las la dbang ba dang*/ skye ba la dbang ba dang*/ mos pa la dbang dang*/ chos la dbang ba dang*/ smon lam la dbang ba dang*/ rdzu 'phrul la dbang ba dang*/ ye shes la dbang ba dang ldan te 'dod rgu la dbang ba byed cing*/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che dang ldan te/ bdag dang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ thams cad la spyod cing yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig

/sangs rgyas kyi zhing rtogs pa bgyid par gyur cig /sems can yongs su smin par bgyid pa dang*/ rnam par grol bar bgyid par gyur cig /bdag dang gzhan gyi don du pha rol tu phyin pa bcu po/ spyin pa dang*/ tshul khrims dang*/ bzod pa dang*/ brtson 'grus dang*/ bsam gtan dang*/ shes rab dang*/ thabs dang*/ stobs dang*/ smon lam dang*/ ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bgyid par gyur cig /byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu myur du yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /de bzhin gshegs pa stobs bcu dang*/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad dang*/ thugs rje chen po dang*/ shin tu dag pa bzhi la sogs pa yon tan gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa myur du thob cing*/ sems can gyi don du 'jig rten gyi khams chos kyi dbyings kyi mtha' klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa/ phyi ma'i mtha' thug pa'i bar du sems can gyi don mdzad pa la mthu dang ldan par gyur cig /bdag ni nam 'chi bar gyur pa'i dus de na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis phyag g.yas pa gser gyi kha dog can/ bdag gi spyi bor bzhag nas lung ston par gyur cig /ci nas bdag dngos pa thams cad la mi rtag pa'i rgyan thogs pa ma mchis pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su bsgom pa'i sems dang*/ tshor ba thams cad rgyun chad pa'i sems kyis/ 'chi ba'i dus bgyid par gyur cig /dad pa grangs ma mchis pa dang*/ rim gro gus pas bgyis pa grangs ma mchis pa dang*/ dga' ba dang*/ mos pa grangs ma mchis pa dang*/ sangs rgyas de dag la lta zhing rtogs la kun tu smra zhing yang dag par smra ba bzhin du/ 'chi ba'i dus bgyid par gyur cig /mchod pa yid du 'ong bas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag la mchod cing*/ me tog dang*/ spos dang*/ 'phreng ba dang*/ byug pa dang*/ phye ma dang*/ na bza' dang*/

gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan dpag tu ma mchis pa rnams kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag la mchod cing lta ba rtogs pa bzhin du// bdag gis kyang dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo bar bgyi'o// gtso bo dam pa dang*/ khyad par 'phags pa dang*/ rab dang*/ phul dang*/ bla na ma mchis pa dang*/ gong na ma mchis pa dang*/ mnyam pa ma mchis pa dang*/ mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa dang*/ mtshungs pa ma mchis pa dang*/ snang ba ma mchis pa dang*/ bdag nyid chen po dang*/ bla ma dang zil gyis mi gnon pa dang*/ yon tan gyi mchog thams cad sdud pa dang*/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bka' bstsal pa/ yongs su bsngo bas yongs su bsngo'o// ci ltar bdag gis yongs su bsngo ba de bzhin du/ 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams ma lus pa thams cad na sems can ci tsam/ sems can gyi khams na ma mchis pa/ sems can gyi khams de dag thams cad kyi ched du yongs su bsngo'o// dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag la shes kyis/ 'dzin par 'dod pa 'di dag gis kyang rjes su yi rang ngo*// zhes brjod par bya'o// dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal cing sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ smon lam gdab pa'i mdo rdzogs so/// /sarba maṅga laṃ// bdag gis rig sngags 'di grub par gyur cig /oṃ bi pu la garbhe/ ma ṇi pra bhe/ ta thā ga ta ni darsha ni/ ma ṇi ma ṇi/ su pra bhe/ bhi ma le/ sā ga ra gaṃ bhi ra hūṃ hūṃ/ dzwa la dzwa la/ buddha bi lo ki te/ gu hya a dhiṣṭhī te garbhe swā hā/ padmo dha re/ a mo gha dza ya te/ tsu ru tsu ru swā hā/ sdig sgrib kun 'joms pa'i rtsa ba'i sngags so/// /bkra shis/// /
